prompts.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four-frame ONE-SHOT crescent melee sword-slash VFX sprite atlas for a small top-down 2D science-fiction game. No characters or weapons, ONLY the air slash trail. Native transparent background.
Make a perfectly regular 2-column by 2-row 1024x1024 atlas, each 512x512 cell one phase, chronological reading order. Each cell shares the SAME invisible circle center at local (256,256) and the SAME radius 208 px. Face toward screen RIGHT. Draw a graceful narrow crescent of energy ONLY on the rightmost 100-degree arc of this invisible circle, from -50 degrees to +50 degrees about rightward. This is a curved arc, open toward the left, with sharp tapered points at top-right and bottom-right. The circle center and left two-thirds of each cell are EMPTY transparent space, since the character will stand at the circle center. Crescent outermost right boundary near local x464, endpoints around local (390,96) and (390,416); do not center the crescent itself inside the cell. Do not draw a full ring.
Frame 1: a thin short leading arc beginning the strike. Frame 2: full bright crescent at radius208, crisp sharp white core, restrained pale icy cyan outer rim, slightly wider at rightmost middle, fine cyan trailing edge. Frame 3: same full arc, thinner and softer, beginning to fade; a very small secondary curved wisp inside the main arc is okay. Frame 4: dissipating thin residual arc, mostly translucent, same registered center and radius. Keep width modest (about24px at broadest in a512pxcell), not a giant broad magic swoosh. Clean painted game-sprite style, readable at small display size, minimal soft glow, semi-transparent edges, no aggressive neon or bloom, no starburst, no impact explosion, no circular spell, no gray shadow, no solid black/white/checkered background, no gridlines, letters, labels, borders or logos. Every phase stays within its own cell with at least32px edge margin. The two tips are sharply tapered. This is ONE coherent crescent slash animation, not four different designs.
